strings.text: The last bus has gone. Someone is meeting you anyway.
strings.translation: O último ônibus já foi. Mesmo assim, alguém veio te buscar.

strings.text: The last bus left at 11:40 pm.
Someone is standing on the road. With flowers.
strings.translation: Tem alguém parado na estrada. Com flores.

strings.text: He has come to meet someone. You.
He reached the bus stop and stopped under the lamp.
strings.translation: Ele chegou ao ponto de ônibus e parou sob o poste.
